Black Bananas, Argento, Angine de Poitrine, Bitchin Bajas, Carmen Villain, Nueen and Silvan Strauss were excluded because their useful exact tracks or catalogue windows were already persistent. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/black-bananas-bad-bunch ; https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/argento-miraggi ; https://www.theguardian.com/music/2026/sep/04/add-to-playlist-the-churning-darkness-of-barcelona-producer-nueen-and-the-weeks-best-new-tracks

ADJACENT / EMERGING FOOTWORK RECONSTRUCTION: Pitchfork's Heavee — Unleash review supplied exact routes through beat coalescence, industrial footwork scaffolding and live-instrument / synthesized texture contrasts. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/heavee-unleash

OVERLOOKED HYBRID PERCUSSION: Pitchfork's exact Cleveland — Tusk review supplied a snapping, stuttering acoustic-digital percussion route across techno, electro and UK bass. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/tracks/cleveland-tusk

OVERLOOKED POST-INDUSTRIAL SKETCHES: Pitchfork's Jlin — Embryo EP review supplied exact routes through distorted beat openings, pistoning drums with surrounding silence and a dead-space descent. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/jlin-embryo-ep

FORM-LOOSENING FOOTWORK CATALOGUE: Pitchfork's DJ Taye — Still Trippin' review supplied exact routes through unpredictable tempo-pattern mutation and moving breakbeat/acid/dubstep constructions. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/dj-taye-still-trippin
